title: Correlation Hub for Tracing Interceptors and Error-Breach Matrix
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Our current tracing hooks and metrics pipelines surface raw spans and basic error counts, but teams struggle to correlate model-level failures (nans/timeouts/model-internal) with transport-layer signals (HTTP/gRPC codes, client-side timeouts) and infrastructure overload. Objective: introduce a lightweight Correlation Hub and a companion 'Error-Breach Matrix' dashboard that synthesizes trace-enriched failure types across layers (client, transport, runtime, model) and surfaces dominant breach vectors for SLO alerts and runbook triggers. Scope: deliver a trace interceptor spec, a small correlation service that normalizes failure signatures, enrich spans/metrics with normalized failure_type and failure_source tags, wire enrichment into our metrics/log pipeline, and build Grafana panels + alert rules. Out of scope: new long-term storage for raw traces or changing sampling strategies beyond temporary overrides for debug cycles.
acceptance_criteria: Tracing interceptor implemented and merged: spans emitted by request path include standardized tags: failure_type, failure_source, failure_signature_id
Correlation Hub service deployed in staging that ingests trace events and returns normalized failure signatures within 50ms median latency
Metrics pipeline mapping: failure_type is available as a dimension in token-latency and request-count metrics for the last 30 days in BigQuery/metrics-store
Grafana 'Error-Breach Matrix' dashboard ready with panels for: timeout vs. overload frequencies, model-error vs transport-code breakdown, and top-10 failure_signature_id trends

Three alert rules authored: (1) sudden spike in model_error rate > 3x baseline, (2) HTTP 5xx correlated with infrastructure overload signals, (3) tail-latency degradation when KV cache hit rate drops below threshold
Runbook section added that maps matrix cells to remediation playbooks and priority owners
tasks: Design interceptor API: add lightweight correlation headers and span attributes (Maya)
Prototype Correlation Hub: Python service with in-memory signature mapping and dedupe logic (Diego)
Add instrumentation: update runtime interceptor in serving code to call hub when span error occurs (Eng team)
Pipeline integration: map failure_type tag to metrics pipeline schema and add to daily aggregation job (SRE)
Dashboard panels: implement Error-Breach Matrix in Grafana and add drilldown links to traces (Observability UX)
Alerting: author Prometheus/Grafana alert rules and validate in staging (SRE)
Documentation: Confluence doc for failure taxonomy and example enrichment payloads (PM)
Post-deploy smoke: housekeeping script to verify enrichment on 1000 sampled requests (QA)
Security review: quick review of correlation hub headers for PII leakage (Security)
Canary rollout: enable interceptor for 10% of traffic then 50% then 100% with metrics gates (Oncall/Release)
comments: 2026-02-25 Maya Chen: Initial ticket — prompted by oncall post-mortem where model timeouts were reported but dashboards showed only HTTP 504 without model context. Proposed Correlation Hub to normalize signatures and enable consistent dashboarding.

2026-02-28 Diego Alvarez: Spike complete. Prototype correlates trace error messages (regex-based) into 12 canonical signatures (e.g., MODEL_NAN, KV_OVERLOAD, INFER_TIMEOUT, HTTP_502_BACKEND). PR: github.com/redwood/observability/pull/452

2026-03-02 Priya Nair (SRE): Confirmed pipeline schema change needed — adding 'failure_type' as a label will increase cardinality but is acceptable if we cap signature space and rollup to 'failure_family' for high-cardinality cases.

2026-03-04 Design review (Liam O'Connor): Dashboard mockups look good; request a heatmap cell for 'model_error x transport_code' and a stacked time-series for signature drift. Suggested color palette and accessibility checks.

2026-03-06 Security note (Aria Singh): Quick review done. Ensure no raw prompt text or user PII is sent to the Correlation Hub; we must only send hashed identifiers and standardized error strings. Added checklist item to tasks.

2026-03-09 Diego Alvarez: Implemented signature cache with LRU eviction and 95th percentile response time 28ms in staging. PR: github.com/redwood/observability/pull/478 — requesting review from SRE and runtime owners.

2026-03-11 Maya Chen: Started Grafana panels; initial query uses failure_family dimension for aggregation. Q: Should runbook mapping be embedded in dashboard as a drilldown or maintained in Confluence? PM prefers Confluence links for editability.
2026-03-12 Priya Nair: Validated alerts in staging. Model-error alert fired during synthetic load test (expected). Recommend threshold tuning before production rollout (added task).
notes: Trade-offs: We prefer a small centralized service vs. pushing regex normalization into every service to keep updates centralized; this adds a network hop but caching mitigates latency.
Future: if signature space grows, add lightweight ML fingerprinting for model-error clustering (backlog).
Observability concern: limit tag cardinality by exposing both failure_type (low-cardinality) and failure_signature_id (high-cardinality) and only index the former in hot metrics stores.
